purpose: Serving-output equivalence across the optimized-vLLM A/B: the same six readiness prompts served by the stage-entry arm (both knobs off) and the shipped arm, same server flags, greedy and sampled. Greedy identity is the output-level counterpart of the bitwise logits identity in bucket_numerics.json. Sampled completions are expected to differ: the sampled arm runs at temperature with no request seed, so it is nondeterministic by construction in both arms.
control: doc/full_model/qualitative/ holds the HF control and the full-model TT completions on the same six prompts; the visible reasoning scaffold is this checkpoint's own style, established there.

What are the three laws of thermodynamics?
